verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Meltano supports per-stream selection (choosing which streams/tables to extract) and tracks incremental replication state per job, which together enable running a pipeline for just one table and resuming/continuing from a specific state — the building blocks for backfill/resync of a single table. However, there is no explicit documentation of a 'full-refresh' or 'resync' flag/workflow or state-reset command for a single table cited in evidence. Missing for 10: explicit doc/example of full-refresh or state-clearing for a single stream, and any community/hands-on confirmation of this specific backfill workflow.
